description: The Japanese firm has consolidated its cryptocurrency portfolio around Bitcoin after selling four altcoins. Ethereum accounted for the largest sale by value, while Solana generated the second-highest gain. Remixpoint also earned JPY 29.8 million from ETH and SOL staking between July 2025 and August 2026.
title: Remixpoint Dumps Altcoins as It Shifts Crypto Strategy Towards Bitcoin

description: Perplexity announced the Hybrid Compute feature. This lets users work with AI on data without the information leaving their device by dividing each task between the cloud and a local model on their Mac. A privacy gate on the Mac controls what information leaves the machine. This feature is now available to Perplexity Pro, Max, and Enterprise subscribers.
title: Perplexity Launches Hybrid Compute Feature for Mac to Keep Sensitive Data Local

description: YAM Finance faces a potential governance takeover after an attacker accumulated enough voting power to submit a proposal targeting the protocol’s Timelock. If approved and executed, the proposal could give the attacker administrative control over YAM contracts and the DAO treasury. About $337,000 (roughly Rs. 3.1 crore) in assets could be exposed, though no treasury funds had been lost when the warning was issued.
title: YAM Finance Hit by Governance Attack, $337,000 in Assets Exposed

description: Pearl Abyss has released a new playable demo for Crimson Desert that be directly streamed on a desktop browser. The 20-minute demo is powered by Amazon GameLift Streams and is available on Twitch. A stable high-speed internet connection is required to stream the demo.
title: Crimson Desert Has a New Playable Demo That Can Be Directly Streamed on a Desktop Browser

description: Samsung could raise prices of the Galaxy A17, Galaxy A27, Galaxy F17 and Galaxy A07 5G in India, according to a leaked price revision document. The Galaxy A17 variants listed with TA could see the steepest increases, with some prices reportedly rising by more than Rs. 14,000. The other models may also receive price increases across multiple configurations. The reported revisions come as smartphone makers face higher memory and component costs, which have contributed to price increases across several segments in recent months.
title: Samsung Galaxy A17, Galaxy A27, Galaxy F17, Galaxy A07 5G Prices Reportedly Hiked in India

description: OpenAI published a blog post on Tuesday detailing its new model Astra. The company says that Astra meets the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under our Preparedness Framework. It is claimed to be capable of spotting previously unknown security flaws and developing ways to exploit them across many well-protected systems without human intervention. Astra will be available soon, but access to its most advanced cybersecurity capabilities will be more limited.
title: OpenAI Teases Astra, Says It Is the First Model to Meet ‘Critical Cybersecurity Threshold'

description: Google has announced its September Android Drop, whcih brings several new features to compatible Android devices. Among the notable announcements is the expansion of the Gemini integration to Find Hub. Meanwhile, Android 17 has a new Motion Assist feature that can help reduce motion sickness when using phone in a moving vehicle. Other notable features include Guided vision though Gemini Live, Google Keep integration in the Messages app, and custom chat themes with different backgrounds.
title: Google’s September Android Drop Brings Gemini Item Tracking, Motion Assist and Chat Themes

description: Mivi has confirmed the name of its upcoming smartphone as Mivi One 5G. It will launch soon in India, but the exact launch date is still under wraps. It supports 5G connectivity and is confirmed to run on a Qualcomm Snapdragon 5G chipset. It is rumoured to be launched in the sub-Rs 15,000 segment.
title: Mivi One 5G Confirmed as Company’s First Smartphone in India; Chipset Teased

description: Vivo T5 5G was launched in India on Wednesday. The handset comes at a starting price of Rs. 34,999 for the base 6GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration. It gets a 3D curved display that tapers into the mid-frame on either side of the phone, which is unique at this price point. The Vivo T5 5G is set to go on sale in India later this month via Flipkart, and will be available for purchase in Royal Bronze and Silver Green colour options, both of which look decent.
title: Vivo T5 5G First Impressions

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27 Plus have reportedly appeared on China’s 3C certification database with model numbers SM-S9520 and SM-S9560. The listings indicate that the two phones could retain 25W and 45W wired charging, respectively. These speeds would match the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Plus. Samsung has also kept 25W charging on its standard Galaxy S models since 2020. The upcoming phones are additionally rumoured to feature built-in magnets for MagSafe-style accessories, although their wireless charging speeds may remain unchanged.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27 Plus 3C Listing Reportedly Reveals Charging Speeds

description: Wallets associated with the CYBERLEEK memecoin reportedly moved about $350,000 in liquidity provider fees following the release of unauthorised GTA VI footage, according to on-chain researcher Conor Grogan. The funds were routed through multiple over-the-counter service providers. However, blockchain data does not establish who controlled the wallets or prove that the wallet owner was responsible for the game footage leaks.
title: GTA VI Leak-Linked Wallets Made $350,000 From CYBERLEEK Liquidity Fees, Analyst Says

description: BGMI players can claim yet another set of free in-game rewards as Krafton India has released new redeem codes for September 2. The latest batch includes 50 redeem codes, with White Rabbit Backpack, a cosmetic item with a pearl-white finish, rabbit ears and pastel detailing, offered as the top reward. The codes are part of the game's 5th Anniversary Edition 4.5 Update celebrations and can be redeemed through the official BGMI website. Players, however, will need to act quickly as there is an individual limit as well as a deadline on the validity of the BGMI redeem codes.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for September 2: How to Get White Rabbit Backpack and Other Free Rewards

description: Netflix has announced that GTA's extended look trailer amassed 31.1 million views, making it the most watched English movie on the streaming platform. GTA 6: An Extended Look topped the streamer's global Top 10 movies list in the week of August 24 to August 30, reaching 31.1 million views in just four days.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look Tops Netflix's Top 10 List With 31.1 Million Views

description: iQOO Z12 Lite 5G is now reportedly listed on the IMEI database with model number I2603. The entry suggests that the handset is currently in the internal testing stage. The iQOO Z12 Lite 5G is rumoured to come with a 6.77-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It could run on a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 chipset. It could feature an 8,000mAh battery with 33W charging support.
title: iQOO Z12 Lite 5G Reportedly Listed on IMEI Database; Key Specifications Leaked

description: A new model of the Vivo V80 Lite has now been listed for pre-order on Vivo Malaysia’s website. The handset, which appears very different from the Vivo V80 Lite and the Vivo S2 launched in India and other countries, will have a 10,000mAh battery and will be available in three memory variants in the country.
title: Vivo V80 Lite with 10,000mAh Battery Listed for Pre-Order in Malaysia, Key Details Revealed

description: Meta has introduced Muse Voice Transcribe, a real-time speech model that can transcribe conversations while identifying individual speakers and detecting when they start or stop talking. The model supports more than 70 languages, including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam, with 25 languages validated for the initial release. It can process recordings longer than an hour and distinguish over 20 speakers. Muse Voice Transcribe also handles code-switching and is available through the Meta Model API for developers.
title: Meta Launches Muse Voice Transcribe With Support for 5 Indian and 70+ Global Languages

description: Bitcoin has slipped below Rs. 73.6 lakh as rising oil prices, Treasury yields and stronger expectations of a September Fed rate hike weigh on risk appetite. Institutional demand remains supportive, with August recording strong spot Bitcoin ETF inflows. Investors are now watching the US jobs report for fresh clues on monetary policy.
title: Bitcoin Holds Below $77,000 as Middle East Tensions Pressure Crypto Market

description: Nothing is reportedly rasing the prices of the Nothing Phone (4a), Phone (4a) Pro, and Phone (4b) in India. A leaker claims that the company will raise the prices of the three recently launched smartphones by up to Rs. 5,000. Moreover, the prices will reportedly be increased across variants. He highlights that after the price hike, the base 8GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration of the Nothing Phone (4a) will cost Rs. 44,999, while the 8GB + 256GB and 12GB + 256GB models will be priced at Rs. 49,999 and Rs. 50,999, respectively.
title: Nothing Phone (4a) Series, Phone (4b) Series to Receive Another Price Hike in India: What You Need to Know

description: Gemini Notebook’s Short Video Overviews are expanding their language support with more than 70 new languages and three English variants for Australia, the UK and India. The feature turns documents, notes and links into vertical videos lasting around 60 seconds, with the content presented in the selected language. Google is rolling out the update on web and mobile for Ultra and Pro users. The company has also recently introduced flexible usage limits, which refresh every five hours and allow users to defer some generated outputs.
title: Gemini Notebook Short Video Overviews Get Support for 70+ More Languages, Three English Variants

description: Vivo T5 5G has been launched in India as the latest addition to the company's mid-range T lineup. The smartphone is set to go on sale in India later this month via Flipkart. The Vivo T5 5G is offered in two colourways, namely Royal Bronze and Silver Green. The Vivo T5 5G sports a 6.83-inch 1.5K (1,260 x 2,800 pixels) 3D Curved AMOLED display, with up to a 144Hz refresh rate. Powering the Vivo T5 5G is the 4nm octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7500 Turbo chipset. For optics, the Vivo T5 5G carries a dual rear camera unit.
title: Vivo T5 5G Launched in India With 7,050mAh Battery, 6.83-Inch 3D Curved Display: Price, Specifications

description: The Philips S7221 5G has arrived in India via Amazon, with the company offering two RAM configurations. The handset features a 6.67-inch HD+ display and runs Android 16. It includes dual 5G SIM support and a 5,700mAh battery aimed at extended daily use. Photography hardware comprises a 64-megapixel rear camera and a 16-megapixel selfie camera. Philips has also added AI scene optimisation and a portrait mode. The phone starts at Rs. 20,499 for the 6GB RAM model.
title: Philips S7221 5G Launched in India With 64-Megapixel Main Camera, 5,700mAh Battery

description: Xiaomi recently begun teasing the Redmi 17 series in India. So far, only the launch of the Redmi 17 has been confirmed, while the Xiaomi 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max are also in line for a debut. Ahead of launch, a tipster has leaked the pricing of the upcoming handsets from the Xiaomi sub-brand. Both models are expected to be positioned in the mid-range, although they could be considerably more expensive than their predecessors.
title: Redmi 17, Redmi Note 17 Pro Price in India, Storage Variants Leaked Ahead of Launch

description: Xiaomi has announced a launch timeline for its Xiaomi 18 Fold foldable. The event will take place in China on 7 September. Xiaomi will announce its new foldable, Pad 9 Pro Max tablet, and N70 and N90 EVs at the same event. The brand will also introduce its Xring O3 processor, which was showcased separately at an earlier event.
title: Xiaomi 18 Fold, Pad 9 Pro Max Set to Launch on September 7 With New Xring O3 Chip

description: iQOO 16 could launch in China soon. Ahead of the official launch, a tipster has shared alleged renders of the unannounced iQOO 16 on Weibo. The images indicate a redesigned rear camera module compared to the iQOO 15. It suggests a square-shaped camera with rounded corners. The upcoming phone could feature a triple rear camera module. It could come with Qualcomm's upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset.
title: iQOO 16 Leak Reveals Redesigned Rear Camera Module, Triple Cameras Tipped

description: Nvidia has announced that its controversial DLSS 5 graphics upscaler, which was roundly mocked and criticised when it was unveiled in March, will official release this week. The AI-powered upscaler will be available to Nvidia RTX 50 series and GeForce Now users on September 3.
title: Nvidia's DLSS 5 Graphics Upscaler Launches in NBA 2K27 This Week Amidst 'AI Slop' Backlash

description: Dragonwing Q-2390 and IQ-2390 processors unveiled ahead of the IFA. The new chips support applications ranging from retail and smart home products to smart displays and enterprise edge devices. Both processors feature a quad-core Qualcomm Kryo CPU and a Qualcomm Adreno 704 GPU. Dragonwing Q-2390 is designed for edge-intelligent commercial, enterprise and consumer products.
title: Qualcomm Dragonwing Q-2390 and IQ-2390 Processors Announced for Commercial and Consumer Devices

description: Poco has announced the X8 5G for global markets with a 6.83-inch 1.5K AMOLED display, Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 chipset and up to 12GB RAM. The smartphone features a 50-megapixel rear camera, IP69K-rated protection and an 8,340mAh battery with 67W charging. It is expected to launch in India on September 4 with a larger 9,000mAh battery.
title: Poco X8 5G Launched Globally with Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 SoC, 8,340mAh Battery

description: Sonos announced on Tuesday announced its next-generation audio operating system dubbed Sonos 27. As per the US-based high-end audio equipment company, the OS has several new features, including a redesigned app, AI-powered controls, and new ways to move sound between devices. Alongside, Sonos is bringing two of its global products, including the Sonos Beam Ultra and the Sonos Ace Ultra to India, which are expected to join its flagship lineup.
title: Sonos 27 OS Announced With ChatGPT Integration, Redesigned App; Sonos Play India Launch Set for September 8

description: OpenAI has denied Apple's claims of the AI firm stealing trade secrets in a new court filing, according to a report. The company reportedly said that the iPhone maker failed to present evidence supporting its claims that its former employees stole confidential information about its future products and hardware. OpenAI reportedly said that the “dispute is a mess of Apple’s own making”. Further, the AI firm said Apple is trying to blame everyone else for not being able to safeguard its own trade secrets.
title: OpenAI Refutes Apple’s Trade Secret Theft Claims, Blames iPhone Maker for the ‘Mess’: Report

description: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max will be launched in three colour options, according to a tipster. He claims that the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max will be launched in “Burgundy, Pure Black, and Sky Blue” (translated from Chinese) colour options. This means that with the iPhone 18 Pro series, the Cupertino tech giant will be abandoning all three shades of last year’s iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max. The flagship iPhone models were launched in September 2025 in Cosmic Orange, Deep Blue, and Silver colourways. The shades of the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro series appear to be notably different from its predecessor.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Series to Launch This Month in Three New Colour Options, Tipster Claims

description: Apple’s leadership change has finally taken place, with John Ternus taking over as Chief Executive Offers on September 1. While the company’s former Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering is expected to address the public for the first time at the September 9 event, the updated leadership page on Apple website offers an early indication of the new CEO’s priorities. Ternus’ new biography places particular emphasis on product reliability and durability, along with materials and hardware design aimed at reducing Apple’s carbon footprint.
title: Apple's New CEO John Ternus Signals Focus on Durability, Repairability and Sustainability

description: JioHotstar has been launched globally, the company announced on Wednesday. The online streaming platform is now available in three new countries, including the UK, Singapore, and Canada, marking its global debut outside India. The company has introduced quarterly plans for the new markets for the first time, in addition to its annual plans. The company has also announced that multiple popular shows and movies will be part of its catalogue globally, including originals like Criminal Justice, Special Ops, Chiraiya, Pritam & Pedro, and Asur.
title: JioHotstar Goes Global With Expansion Into Three New Markets; Announces New Originals and Game Show Format
